correctness.rationale: Baranwal et al Theorem 11 and Proposition 18 permit replacement of the infinite antisquare ban for periodic words by eight explicit forbidden factors, and the cyclic Pansiot transition code then has zero-runs at least two and one-runs exactly two/four. The minority bit occurs as isolated ones with cyclic background gaps either one or >=3 and no adjacent short gaps. Uniquely circularly decipherable blocks 1 0^g and 1 0 1 0^g (g>=3) give the bivariate zeta factors; circular independent-set placement and stars-and-bars yield the exact C_{n,t} formula, sharp support n>=3r+(r mod 2), and six border configurations at n divisible by six. Independent exhaustive direct forbidden-factor enumeration of every marked word n=1..13 matched the coefficient formula, including A_12; that finite check does not prove the general formal identity.

originality.rationale: The 2023 primary paper proves the forbidden patterns, transition-run structure and unrefined growth. A published 2026 periodic-orbit result gives precisely the specialization at u=1 and ordinary orbit counts; a 2026 maximal-entropy/zeta finding also gives an algebraically equivalent unweighted zeta factorization. Those are genuine prior coverage but do not determine the separate Hamming-weight classes. The audited two-variable zeta and complete exact fixed-composition support/multiplicities are not equivalent to those univariate claims. PASS best of knowledge with residual risk of an equivalent earlier multivariate renewal-shift enumerator.

General multivariate zeta/renewal literature may have an identical weight enumeration under different notation.
The circular block formula requires treating nonprimitive periods carefully; checked by the derivation and finite tests, not by numerical evidence alone.

value.rationale: The exact constant-composition spectrum and parity-sensitive forbidden middle-density interval are natural structural invariants of a well-studied antisquare-avoidance subshift. Recovering all weights and the six equality words is not simply reprinting the known unweighted zeta; it permits exact fixed-weight constrained circular-word enumeration for every length and resolves an arithmetic support phenomenon.

limitations: Only two-sided periodic extensions of binary marked-origin words; arbitrary finite prefixes, other alphabets and nonperiodic words are excluded.
Unweighted prior formulas and forbidden-pattern classification are credited, not claimed as discoveries.
